params.message:
Store plain ids, not Sanity references

Writers stored topic tags as the caller passed them, and callers still build
{_ref, _type} objects: 77,192 concepts and 6,143 patterns carried them on
2026-09-29, written every day. plainIds (concept-id.mjs) now normalises every list
the store writes: writeConcept, writePattern, the source writer and the generic
patch path the dashboard edits through. bin/plain-ids.mjs rewrites what was stored
before, dry by default, in one transaction, every previous value in plain_ids_undo.
